column1: # hw-measure (page-kind-handwriting), 2026-10-15: three readers on the truth set's 19 handwritten and 2 mixed pages (HW-PAGES-2026-10-15.tsv),
# each page through the production pipeline once per reader (Tools/score-gate.swift's harness taking images, built from e9311b5's Sources plus this commit's detector, which nothing calls yet;
# accurate mode; vision = no model reader, falcon-ocr and paddleocr-vl set for every kind of page, so a photographed page takes its photograph pair:
# falcon-ocr align, paddleocr-vl regions). Text through PDFKit page.string; scored against the whole-page transcription with
# ops/ocrlab/score-bakeoff.py's norm/tokens/matched, as a bag (a truth word missed when no reading word matches it, order ignored);
# truth words containing [illegible] left out (81 markers), so 2,825 handwritten and 202 mixed words are scored. added = reading words matching no truth word.
# Small sample, one archive's hands. Not comparable with Archive Suite's panel figures (its own normalisation and measure).
# Seconds a page, wall through the harness (about 18 s of each is the harness's own start-up, reasoned from Vision's 20.3): vision 20.3, paddleocr-vl 21.3, falcon-ocr 56.6.
# Totals, missed per 1,000: handwritten vision 561, paddleocr-vl 454, falcon-ocr 409; mixed 257, 228, 223.
